DEWALT DCG405N-XJ 18V XR cordless angle grinder offers efficient, powerful performance for demanding cutting and grinding tasks on metal, masonry, and concrete. Features an advanced brushless motor to provide improved runtime, reliability, and consistent power, ideal for professional use. The robust construction ensures durability in tough conditions, and the compact gear case allows access to tight spaces. Safety and comfort are enhanced by an ergonomic handle, 2-position side handle, and an electronic brake for rapid disc stopping. Includes a hex wrench for convenient accessory changes and adjustments. Compatible with all Dewalt 18V XR Li-Ion batteries and chargers (sold separately).
b: Does Not Include Battery or Charger
